messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up @channel — launching a new micro-attestation flow today to speed up SOC2/ISO evidence collection. Instead of one big upload, each team should nominate an evidence champion who will gather and validate artifacts for controls your team owns. Deadline: Mon Apr 14 COB. Details + short checklist here: https://confluence.redwood.ai/compliance/micro-attest

Andrew (Eng): Quick q — does the champion have to be a manager or can an IC volunteer?

Maya (People Ops): Managers should approve the champion nomination, but ICs can volunteer and be approved by their manager. Use the short nomination form on the Confluence page (link above).

Jess (Security): Note for champions: auditors will sample config screenshots, access lists, and 2 months of ACL/log exports. Please ensure sensitive values are redacted and screenshots include timestamps.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — evidence-champion nominations close in 72 hours. Auto-reminders will go out at 48h and 24h.

Sam (Legal): Two small legal asks: 1) include contractor hires in your evidence unless you have a documented exclusion; 2) if any artifact contains PII, follow the redaction guidance on the checklist before uploading. Ping me if you need an exception.

Maya (People Ops): We're running two 30-min drop-in office hours for anyone who needs help with the checklist or nominations: Thu 10:30–11:00 PT and Fri 15:00–15:30 PT. If you can't make either, DM me and we can schedule a short sync. :calendar:

Andrew (Eng): Thanks — I'll nominate Samir and upload the team's runbook screenshot by end of week.

Maya (People Ops): Quick checklist snippet that champions should run through before marking "Ready for audit":

```
- Control owner assigned (name + role)
- Artifact uploaded (Confluence link)
- Evidence redacted where necessary (no PII in screenshots)
- Reviewer assigned (peer or manager)
- Manager attestation completed (checkbox + timestamp)
```

Jess (Security): One more tip — for infra exports include region and generation timestamp in the filename (e.g., vpc-acls-20260401-us-west-2.json). Makes auditor sampling much faster.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Please prioritize nominations this week and use the Confluence form. I'll post the consolidated champion list on Friday afternoon. :thumbsup:

Andrew (Eng): Done — nomination submitted and runbook uploaded: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=7890123
